note: mhnsw_ef_search 80 was set before measuring (the starter's value) and is the value F5.7 gates: recall 96.8% on 200 frozen questions. It is not enough on its own: at ef 80 HNSW loses the whole answer on ~2% of questions (4 of 200; 1 at ef 400), where the answer sits in a tight cluster of paragraph versions. Step 6 recommendation (docs/findings.md, Step 4): rank with exact cosine over the paragraphs alive at the chosen date, and use HNSW only to route, at ef >= 400.
